about: The residents an AI plays in the recorded conversations with Chhaya's agent (scripts/record_ai_calls.py). Facts are told only when asked. expected_tier is what the triage rules give when the agent records the facts as the guidance describes them.

personas.situation: An older woman at home with her son's family on a hot day, feeling well.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting, no cramps, no weakness.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking plenty of water and eating normally; the matka at home is full.
facts.company: Your son and daughter-in-law are at home with you all day.
facts.home: The ceiling fan works and the inner room stays cool.
facts.going_out: You will stay inside until evening.

personas.situation: A man in his sixties who lives alone, well and managing on a hot day.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting, no weakness.
facts.water_and_food: You drink water all day and have enough at home; you ate rotis in the morning.
facts.company: You live alone and are alone today.
facts.home: You have a cooler that works.
facts.going_out: You will stay indoors in the afternoon.

personas.situation: An older woman with diabetes who is well, takes her tablets and has family at home.

facts.feeling: You feel well. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting, no weakness.
facts.water_and_food: You drink water regularly and have enough at home.
facts.company: Your husband and grandson are at home.
facts.home: The fan works and you sit in the shaded room.
facts.going_out: You will not go out today.
facts.medicine: You take sugar tablets every day and have enough for a month.

personas.situation: An older woman at home with family who has had a headache since noon from the heat.

facts.feeling: You have a headache since noon and feel a bit tired. No vomiting, no fainting, no confusion, no chest pain, breathing is fine.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough at home.
facts.company: Your daughter-in-law is at home.
facts.help: You need nothing, you will rest.

personas.situation: An older man with a heart condition who has leg cramps and heavy sweating today.

facts.feeling: You have cramps in your legs and you are sweating a lot. No chest pain, no trouble breathing, no fainting, no confusion, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and have enough at home.
facts.company: Your wife is at home with you.
facts.medicine: You take heart tablets daily and have enough for two weeks.

personas.situation: A very old man who has hardly drunk anything since morning and does not feel like eating.

facts.feeling: You feel fine, just no appetite. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You have drunk only one glass of water since morning and skipped lunch. There is water at home.
facts.company: Your son's family is at home.

personas.situation: A woman in her sixties living alone whose water at home is running short.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: Only half a bucket of water is left; the tap water did not come today, so you are drinking less to save it.
facts.company: You live alone and are alone today.
facts.help: You need nothing for now, the neighbour may bring water in the evening.

personas.situation: An older woman alone at home with no water since morning because the tanker did not come.

facts.feeling: You feel thirsty and your mouth is dry, otherwise no dizziness, no vomiting, no fainting, no chest pain.
facts.water_and_food: There is no water at all at home; the tanker did not come and you have not had water since morning.
facts.company: You live alone and nobody is with you today.
facts.going_out: You cannot walk to the hand pump, it is too far.
facts.help: You would like someone to bring water.

personas.situation: An older man with family at home whose village water supply was cut; a little stored water is left.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: The supply has been off for two days; there is only one matka of water left for the whole family, so everyone is drinking less.
facts.company: Your wife and sons are at home.
facts.help: You need nothing; your son has gone to arrange a tanker.

personas.situation: A very old woman alone at home who feels dizzy when she stands up.

facts.feeling: You feel dizzy when you stand up and a little weak. You have not fainted, you are not confused, no chest pain, breathing is fine, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough at home.
facts.company: You are alone; your son works in Jaipur.
facts.help: You need nothing, you will lie down.

personas.situation: An older man with a heart condition who has chest pain and is short of breath right now.

facts.feeling: Your chest has been hurting for half an hour and you cannot breathe properly. You are sweating a lot.
facts.company: Your wife is in the next room.

personas.situation: A son answers his mother's phone; she fainted in the courtyard a few minutes ago and is very drowsy.

facts.who_you_are: You are her son. She cannot come to the phone.
facts.feeling: She fainted in the courtyard a few minutes ago; she opened her eyes but is very drowsy and her skin is very hot.
facts.company: You and your wife are with her.

personas.situation: A granddaughter answers; her grandfather is confused, talking strangely and has very hot dry skin.

facts.who_you_are: You are his granddaughter. He cannot talk on the phone properly.
facts.feeling: Since noon he is confused, does not recognise you, talks strangely, and his skin is very hot and dry. He has stopped sweating.
facts.company: You are with him.

personas.situation: A daughter-in-law answers; her mother-in-law has gone to the temple and she does not know how she is feeling today.

facts.who_you_are: You are her daughter-in-law. She is not at home.
facts.feeling: You do not know how she is feeling; you were working in the fields since morning and have not seen her.
facts.water_and_food: There is water at home.
facts.company: The family lives with her.

personas.situation: An older woman who is busy cooking and puts the phone down after a couple of replies.

facts.feeling: You are fine.
facts.water_and_food: You have water.
facts.busy: The milk is boiling on the stove and you have no time to talk.

personas.situation: An older man who answers a few questions and then has to go because a visitor arrived.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough.
facts.company: Your wife is at home.
facts.busy: Guests have arrived at the door and you must go.

personas.situation: A middle-aged construction worker who works in the sun and is managing well.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no cramps.
facts.water_and_food: You carry two bottles of water to the site and refill them; you ate lunch.
facts.company: You work with other labourers and go home to your family.
facts.home: There is a fan at home.
facts.going_out: You have to work at the building site today, but you rest in the shade from one to four.

personas.situation: A farm labourer working in the sun who has a headache and is running out of water at the field.

facts.feeling: You have a headache and feel very tired from the sun. No vomiting, no fainting, no confusion, no chest pain.
facts.water_and_food: Your water bottle is nearly empty and the field is far from the village.
facts.company: Other labourers are with you in the field.
facts.home: There is a fan at home.
facts.going_out: You must keep working in the field until evening.

personas.situation: A woman in her late sixties who has to take the goats out and fetch water in the afternoon.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough at home.
facts.company: Your husband is at home.
facts.going_out: You have to take the goats out and fetch water from the hand pump in the afternoon.

personas.situation: An older woman with high blood pressure whose tablets finished two days ago.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough at home.
facts.company: Your son lives with you.
facts.medicine: Your BP tablets finished two days ago and nobody has gone to the health centre for more.
facts.help: You would like someone to bring your tablets.

personas.situation: An older man with diabetes who has only two days of tablets left.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough at home.
facts.company: Your wife is at home.
facts.medicine: Only two days of sugar tablets are left.
facts.help: You need nothing, your son will buy them on Sunday.

personas.situation: An older woman with family whose electricity has been off since morning; the room is very hot.

facts.feeling: You feel fine apart from the heat. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough at home.
facts.company: Your grandchildren are at home.
facts.home: There has been no electricity since morning, the fan is off and there is no shaded room.

personas.situation: A very old man with his wife at home who would like the health worker to come and check his blood pressure.

facts.feeling: You feel fine. No dizziness, no headache, no vomiting.
facts.water_and_food: You are drinking water and there is enough at home.
facts.company: Your wife is with you.
facts.help: You would like the health worker to come today and check your blood pressure.

personas.situation: An older woman alone at home who has been vomiting again and again and cannot stand up.

facts.feeling: You have been vomiting again and again since morning and you cannot stand up; you feel very weak.
facts.water_and_food: You cannot keep water down.
facts.company: You are alone at home.
